NSPanel_configuration_text: Added the Tasmota NSPanel to Adapter. Overwrite settings with default values. Takes about 40 seconds.
NSPanel_configuration_update_text: Update the Tasmota NSPanel. Overwrite settings with default values. Takes about 40 seconds.
No_data: No data - Adapter might be offline or no panel configured.
activateURLsHelp: Precaution against accidental editing. Activation is not saved.
adapterNotAlive: The adapter is not running or cannot start due to an error. Please check the adapter logs for more information.
auto_layout_confirm_text: Rearranging everything overwrites all saved node positions. Cancel to keep the current positions or Reorder to apply the automatic layout.
auto_layout_nothing_new: All nodes already have a position
auto_layout_place_new_hint: Places only nodes without a saved position next to the page that leads to them - all other nodes stay where they are
channelConfigDialog_brightnessRange: Range of the brightness slider; empty or 0 = panel default
channelConfigDialog_colorTempRange: Range of the color temperature slider; empty or 0 = panel default
channelConfigDialog_duplicateDps: Duplicate datapoints (multiple states match the same role)
channelConfigDialog_isCustomHint: Custom button: The ID must point directly to a state with type=boolean. The selected ID is
channelConfigDialog_longPressHint1: Only for Navigation, Custom Button or ChannelIds with role=button
channelConfigDialog_longPressHint2: Only one of the two options can be used.
channelConfigDialog_longPressHint3: Long press with target datapoint requires a datapoint with type=boolean and write=true
channelConfigDialog_secondRowHint: Text of the second row in the shutter popup (role blind); empty = none
channelConfigDialog_unknownRoleHint: The object's role is not a recognized device type
channelConfigDialog_useColorPlaceholder: This area will be implemented later
channelConfigDialog_useValueConditionsHi: JavaScript expression over val (the current value), e.g. val && val < 100 - the value is shown instead of the icon only while the expression is true, otherwise the icon
channelConfigDialog_valueRangeHint: Range of the volume slider (role volume); empty or 0 = panel default
channelModeListDialog_aliasCheckError: The datapoint could not be checked.
channelModeListDialog_aliasHint: String state the selected mode is written to. Only evaluated for the roles rgbSingle, rgb, ct and hue.
channelModeListDialog_aliasMissing: Datapoint does not exist – the adapter will ignore it.
channelModeListDialog_aliasNotState: The object is not a state.
channelModeListDialog_aliasWrongType: Datapoint type is "%s", string is expected – the mode list is still passed on, but only a string datapoint receives it as valueList2; own common.states of the datapoint take precedence.
channelModeListDialog_confirmText: The check of the selection datapoint failed. Apply the settings anyway?
channelModeListDialog_modeListHint: Blank lines are discarded. The adapter joins the entries with "?" for the panel, so "?" must not be used inside an entry. At most 48 entries and 900 characters (line breaks the adapter inserts included) reach the panel.
channelModeListDialog_selectInfo: Role select: the adapter uses the channel's state %s. Without a mode list it builds the list from its common.states (or those of the alias target); with a mode list the panel shows these entries and writes the index on selection.
channelModeListDialog_statesInfo: The datapoint has its own common.states – the adapter builds the list on the panel directly from them; the mode list only serves as a fallback.
channelModeListDialog_warnQuestionMark: Entries contain "?" – this is the adapter’s separator and cannot be displayed as part of an entry: %s
channelModeListDialog_warnTooLong: The list is %s characters long – the adapter truncates it at %s characters.
channelModeListDialog_warnTooMany: The list has %s entries – the adapter only passes the first %s to the panel.
chart_StateDB: data point for values from the database
chart_XLabelsTooltip: Interval in hours between X-axis labels (e.g., 4 for a label every 4 hours)
chart_XTicksTooltip: Interval in hours between X-axis ticks (e.g., 2 for a tick every 2 hours)
chart_script_navigation_hint: Migrated from the old table "Page Chart": this page still gets its navigation from the script (page "%s"). This is deprecated - assign a navigation here and remove the page from the script.
convertScript_adapterRestarts: The adapter restarts now and uses the new entries from that start on.
convertScript_backupHint: Before the script is changed, the adapter saves a disabled copy as "<script>_1_backup" (older backups move up, at most 4 are kept). The taken over pages are removed from the script and their definitions are commented out.
convertScript_conflictOtherPanels: This also changes the page on the other assigned panels: %s
convertScript_conflicts: Pages of the global script that differ from the admin
convertScript_conflictsHint: These pages of the global script exist in the admin under the same name with a different content. Choose for each page what happens.
convertScript_errorIntro: The adapter reports (if the script has not sent its configuration yet: start the script once, it sends its configuration to the adapter):
convertScript_executeTimeout: The adapter may have finished the conversion nevertheless: check the log of the instance. If the adapter restarted, reload the admin before you change anything else.
convertScript_executing: The adapter takes the configuration over, backs up and changes the script…
convertScript_invalidResponse: The adapter sent an unexpected answer. Is the instance up to date and running?
convertScript_loading: The adapter checks what can be taken over…
convertScript_noBackupHint: Without the script object no backup is created and the script is not changed – only the configuration the adapter stored is converted.
convertScript_noRestartHint: The adapter did not announce a restart – the entries apply with its next start.
convertScript_nothingToDo: Nothing to take over: the script has no page, screensaver or button the admin could take and nothing to remove from the script.
convertScript_partialNotWritten: The admin entries were not written – the script is saved as backup %s, please check the log.
convertScript_partialPending: The admin entries could not be written; the adapter applies them at its next start (stored plan).
convertScript_reason_adminAlreadyNavigat: The admin entry already has its own navigation – the script reference is dead and is removed
convertScript_reason_adminEntryMissing: No matching admin entry found for this script page
convertScript_reason_adminOnly: This page type is configured in the admin only – the script reference is dead and is removed
convertScript_reason_buttonConfigured: This button is already configured in the admin
convertScript_reason_buttonNotSupported: The button action cannot be expressed in the admin
convertScript_reason_fieldNotSupported: A field of the page cannot be expressed in the admin
convertScript_reason_itemNotSupported: An item of the page cannot be expressed in the admin
convertScript_reason_nameExists: A page with this name already exists in the admin
convertScript_reason_screensaverEmpty: The script screensaver has no items and only default settings – nothing to take over
convertScript_reason_screensaverExists: A screensaver for this panel already exists in the admin
convertScript_reason_screensaverItemNotS: An item of the screensaver cannot be expressed in the admin
convertScript_reason_unsupportedPageType: This page type cannot be configured in the admin
convertScript_reloadHint: The adapter has written the instance configuration. The configuration loaded in this admin page is outdated – saving it would overwrite the new entries. Reload the admin before you change anything else.
convertScript_reloadNeeded: The adapter writes the instance configuration itself; the admin has to be reloaded afterwards.
convertScript_reloadRestartHint: The adapter is restarting right now – the admin may briefly show "not connected" until it is back.
convertScript_resultError: The adapter reported an error during the conversion
convertScript_result_pages: %s pages created, %s navigations assigned, %s references removed
convertScript_scriptMissing: The script object does not exist (anymore). The admin entries are created, but the script can neither be backed up nor changed – its configuration stays as the adapter received it last.
convertScript_scriptNotes: Not changed in the script source (please check by hand)
convertScript_scriptRewritten: The script source was changed: taken over pages were removed and their definitions commented out.
convertScript_scriptUntouched: The script source was not changed.
convertScript_storedAs: stored in the admin as "%s" (flagged as start page)
convertScript_summary_buttonsNone: Hardware buttons: none in the script
convertScript_timeout: The adapter did not answer in time.
convertScript_title: Take the script over into the admin – %s
convertScript_unsavedChanges: The instance configuration has unsaved changes. Save them first – the adapter writes the configuration itself, and the admin has to be reloaded afterwards, which discards unsaved changes.
createScriptHelp: Create or update the settings script for the panel
credential_hint: Managed under Admin → System settings → Credentials. A selected entry replaces the field(s) below.
credential_load_error: The list of credentials could not be loaded
credential_missing: The selected credential no longer exists - the field(s) below are used
credential_mqtt: MQTT login from the central credentials (external broker only)
credential_qr: Wifi password from the central credentials
credential_tasmota: Tasmota WebUI password from the central credentials
defaultValueCardThermoHint: (cardThermo2 only) When enabled, minValue, maxValue and stepValue are specified in tenths (e.g. 25 = 2.5 °C). When disabled, values are used directly (e.g. 2.5 = 2.5 °C).
deletePanelConfirmText: Do you really want to delete the panel '%s'?
deletePanelSuccessText: Panel '%s' has been deleted. Do you want to save the changes?
delete_confirm_text: Do you really want to delete this item?
getRandomMqttCredentialsHelp: Generate random MQTT credentials and get a free port
headline: Headline
hwButtonCoupled: An action is configured, but the button is coupled to its relay - it works only after decoupling.
main_page_disabled_conflict: Not possible: the page "%s" is already the start page for: %p
main_page_disabled_no_panel: Assign a panel first - without an assignment no start page can be set.
main_page_disabled_offline: The adapter is not running - the start page can only be set while the instance runs.
main_page_hint: This page is published as the start page on the assigned panels and replaces a start page coming from the script.
main_page_locks_assignment: Panel assignment and navigation are locked while this page is the start page. Uncheck the start page box under "Page Details" to change them.
media_arrowSlot: Paging arrow (scroll setting 'Arrow') - click shows the next page
media_backendUnsupported: This id does not belong to a supported adapter (alexa2, sonos, spotify-premium, mpd, squeezeboxrpc).
media_checkOffline: The adapter is not running - the player cannot be checked and no names can be read.
media_clickColors: Colors of title, artist and power button
media_colorTitleOnly: Only the Squeezebox player can color the title line.
media_controlsFixed: Shuffle, back, play/pause and next are added by the adapter when the player offers them.
media_itemHint_equalizer: Bass, mid and treble of the Echo device.
media_itemHint_favoriteList: Starts one of the favorites of the player.
media_itemHint_online: Only appears while the player is not reachable - it takes no place otherwise.
media_itemHint_reminder: Shows the reminders of the Echo device.
media_itemHint_speakerList: Selects the speaker or the room group the player plays on.
media_itemHint_trackList: Jumps to a title of the current queue.
media_itemHint_volumePresets: Appears as soon as at least one volume preset is set.
media_listHint_favoriteList: Empty = all favorites, otherwise only these.
media_listHint_playList: Empty = all playlists, otherwise only these.
media_listHint_playList_alexa2: Entries as <end of the data point>.<value>, e.g. Apple-Music-Playlist.Rock - the part after the dot is written to the data point.
media_listHint_playList_sonos: The sonos adapter cannot read the playlists - enter the names of the Sonos playlists here. Without a list the item stays without function.
media_listHint_speakerList: Empty = all speakers the adapter knows, otherwise only these.
media_listNoneOffered: The adapter offers no further names for this list.
media_panelHint: Similar to the panel - click an area to change it. The bar shows the standard items of the player (lock), then the own page items; drag them to change their order.
media_playerError: The adapter does not accept this player:
media_playerId: Player (device, channel or folder - no state)
media_playerIdHint:
Examples:
alexa2.0.Echo-Devices.<id>
sonos.0.root.192_168_1_20
spotify-premium.0
mpd.0
squeezeboxrpc.0.Players.<name>
Without instance number the lowest instance is used.
media_presetsHint: Appear as their own item in the bar; values outside the range are limited to it.
media_stdSlotHint: standard item of the player - click to change
media_volumeHint: Range of the slider on the panel, mapped onto the scale of the player.
mqttIp: IP to the external MQTT server
mqttServer: Use the adapter's own MQTT server
mustBeIp: Must be a valid IP address
nav_all_requires_prev_next: For (all) prev or next must be set
nav_edit_generated_page: Automatically generated page – navigation cannot be changed
nav_edit_legend_hint: Drag the source handles (left/top/bottom) to another page, click an edge to remove it; pale = derived by the adapter
nav_edit_legend_override: script page with navigation overridden in the admin
nav_edit_link_derived: Derived by the adapter (default home or chaining) - cannot be removed
nav_edit_not_assigned: This page is not assigned to this panel in the current configuration - check the assignment in the page configuration tab
nav_edit_override_stale: The script navigation has changed since the change was made
nav_edit_scope_text: The page "%s" takes its navigation from the assignment for all panels. The change can apply to all panels, or only to "%p": then a panel-specific assignment is created, which takes precedence over the one for all panels.
nav_edit_scope_title: Page is assigned to all panels
nav_edit_stale_col_then: Script at the time of the change
nav_edit_stale_keep_hint: The links stay as you changed them; the new script links are only remembered as the new basis
nav_edit_stale_merge_hint: The links you changed stay, every other link follows the script
nav_edit_stale_options_hint: The choice applies to all pages listed. "Later" closes the dialog without a decision; it is not asked again in this session.
nav_edit_stale_take_script_hint: Your change is dropped, the page follows the script again
nav_edit_stale_text: The configuration script of panel "%p" delivers other navigation links for the pages below than it did when you changed their navigation in the admin. Decide how to go on.
nav_edit_unsaved_hint: Changes are applied with 'Save', the adapter restarts then; the final chaining of prev/next is computed by the adapter.
nav_legend_origin_global: page from the global script configuration
nav_legend_state_ref: state a target is read from
nav_next_tooltip: If Next points to a page whose Prev points to a different page, this page will be inserted and the next and prev of the other pages adjusted accordingly. In conflicts, prev has priority.
nav_prev_tooltip: If Prev points to a page whose Next points to a different page, this page will be inserted and the next and prev of the other pages adjusted accordingly. In conflicts, prev has priority.
nav_restart_waiting: Adapter is restarting, the view will be refreshed …
nav_target_missing: "%s" does not exist on these panels: %p
nav_target_only_notice: Without next and prev this page can only be reached via { navigate: 'true', targetPage: 'abc'}
notifyMqttServer: We recommend using the adapter's internal MQTT server, which works directly with the panel. This optimizes data exchange.
openWebPanel: Open web panel in a new tab
pageMenu_cardGrid2_conflict: cardGrid2 is disabled: the assigned panels have different models (some us-p, some not). cardGrid2 requires all panels to use the same model. Switched to cardGrid.
page_link_description: A link shows the content of the linked page (page items and all page settings) under its own name. Navigation, start page, hidden and always on on the right only apply to the link - changes to the content are made on the linked page.
page_link_headline_hint: Empty = headline of the linked page, if that is empty too its unique name
page_link_target_missing: The linked page "%s" does not exist (anymore). The link is not shown on the panel.
page_link_target_required: Select the page whose content this link shows.
page_name_main_locked: Start page - published under the id "main". Name locked while the mark is set; it stays stored unchanged.
page_name_main_reserved: 'main' is reserved - set the start page with the checkbox in the navigation assignment.
page_overrides_script_page: This name already exists as a panel page - the admin page overrides it.
panelButtonDialog_detach: Decouple the button from its relay
panelButtonDialog_detachHint: Switches cmd.detachLeft or cmd.detachRight of the panel. Only a decoupled button reports to the adapter instead of switching its relay.
panelButtonDialog_detachKeeps: The action stored for this button is kept - it works again as soon as the button is decoupled.
panelButtonDialog_detachRequired: Decouple the button first, then the action can be configured.
panelButtonDialog_modeNoneHint: The button keeps what the configuration script says about it.
panelButtonDialog_mode_buttonOffDelayOn: Set false, back to true after the delay
panelButtonDialog_mode_buttonOnDelayOff: Set true, back to false after the delay
panelButtonDialog_notAlive: The instance is not running: the decoupling cannot be read or switched and the list of navigation points stays empty.
panelButtonDialog_pageUnknown: While the instance is stopped the navigation points of this panel are unknown – enter the name as it appears in cmd.goToNavigationPoint.
panelButtonDialog_webInfo: A web panel has no relay – its buttons always run the action below.
powerStateHomeBottom: Data point for Power Home bottom
powerStateHomeTop: Data point for Power Home top
power_iconColor_hint: Disabled when color scale is active
power_negate_supply: Slots that contribute to the sum
power_script_navigation_hint: Migrated from the old table "Page Power": this page still gets its navigation from the script (page "%s"). This is deprecated - assign a navigation here and remove the page from the script.
rememberLastSiteHint: Optional: Remember the last opened page and open it the next time the interface is loaded. If disabled, the page defined as the start page in the settings will be opened.
screensaver_adapterNote: A panel assigned here gets this screensaver when the adapter starts - instead of the one of its script. Version and rotation time come from this entry, the states cmd.screenSaver.layout / rotationTime follow it.
screensaver_date_dialogHint: "Global setting" takes the format of the instance settings; a value here overrides it for this screensaver only.
screensaver_date_hint: Click to set the date format
screensaver_delete_confirm_text: Are you sure you want to delete this screensaver
screensaver_iconSelect_duplicate: Value used more than once: %s – only one of these entries takes effect
screensaver_iconSelect_hint: Each icon applies up to and including its value; above the highest value the icon of the highest value is shown. The list replaces the icon above, the color settings still apply.
screensaver_iconSelect_incomplete: Every entry needs a numeric value and an icon
screensaver_iconSelect_summary: %s icon(s) per value range – replaces the icon above
screensaver_indicator_legend: Frame of the indicators: grey = no key, red = button, green = switch, blue = open page
screensaver_item_actionNotWritable: %s is not writable (common.write) - button and switch need a writable state
screensaver_item_action_hint: Works only with the option "Indicators act as buttons"
screensaver_item_adapterOnly: only objects of the adapter %s are offered
screensaver_item_colorStateHint: value of the state: #rrggbb, {"r":…,"g":…,"b":…} or a decimal number - on an on/off state it applies to "on", "off" takes the default color
screensaver_item_dpInitIsState: This is a single state - the template searches below the object, choose the channel or alias above it
screensaver_item_dpInit_channel: Channel or alias the template searches its states in
screensaver_item_dpInit_none: This template needs no object - it brings its own data
screensaver_item_enabled: State that hides the item while false
screensaver_item_iconRequired: Without an icon the panel cannot draw the item - please choose an icon
screensaver_item_notState: %s is not a state (object type: %s) - please choose a state
screensaver_item_pickState: choose a state - the fields follow its type
screensaver_item_pickTemplate: choose a template - it brings icon, colors and texts; then pick the object it reads
screensaver_item_roleInfo: Role: %s · default icons: %s / %s (preset, can be changed)
screensaver_item_roleNoDefault: Role: %s · no default icons for this role - please choose an icon
screensaver_item_templatesPending: The template list comes from the running adapter - it is not reachable right now
screensaver_model_pending: the places are drawn as soon as a panel is chosen
screensaver_mricon_dialogHint: The icon follows a state: icon on when the state is true, icon off otherwise. An optional second state is printed as value next to it. Without a state the icon is not used.
screensaver_mricon_hint: Click to set the status icon (mrIcon)
screensaver_name_exists: A screensaver with this name already exists
screensaver_notify_buzzerHint: Arguments of the Tasmota Buzzer command: count,on,off,tune
screensaver_notify_contentHint: Each field takes a fixed text or the ID of a state whose value is shown.
screensaver_notify_deleteShared: This notification is also used by %s. Deleting removes it from all screensavers.
screensaver_notify_dismissible: A tap on the screensaver hides the notification until its state switches off and on again
screensaver_notify_dismissibleIdHint: Notifications with the same group ID are hidden together - on all panels.
screensaver_notify_enabledHint: Several states: the notification is shown only while all of them are on.
screensaver_notify_headlineIcon: Icon in front of the headline
screensaver_notify_listHint: All screensavers share this list. Tick a notification to show it on this screensaver - ticked ones are listed first, then by priority. Of several active notifications the panel shows the one with the lowest priority number.
screensaver_notify_nameHint: Optional - only for the overview in the list, not shown on the panel
screensaver_notify_needContent: Nothing to show: fill in the headline (or its prefix, unit, icon) or the text.
screensaver_notify_needEnabled: At least one state is required.
screensaver_notify_needText: Prefix and suffix of the text are only shown with a text.
screensaver_notify_sharedEdit: This notification is also used by %s - changes apply there too.
screensaver_notify_visibleConditionHint: JavaScript expression on the value val of each state, e.g. val >= 3. Empty: the state counts as on/off.
screensaver_overflow: %s item(s) have no place in this version: %s
screensaver_panelHint: The picture shows the places of the chosen version and panel model. Click a free place to add an item, click an item to edit it, drag items to move them; time, date, the status icons and the gear open their settings.
screensaver_panels_duplicate: Panel %s is also assigned to screensaver '%s' - the first entry wins
screensaver_panels_hint: Panels that show this screensaver - a panel can have only one
screensaver_panels_mixed: The selected panels have different models (%s) - the places are drawn for %s
screensaver_panels_none: No panel selected - this screensaver is not used
screensaver_rotationTime_hint: Areas with more items than places page through them; 0 = off
screensaver_select_description: Choose a screensaver from the list to configure it.
screensaver_slot_free: Free place - click to add an item, drop an item here to move it
screensaver_slot_item: %s - click to edit, drag to move
screensaver_unassigned_panels: Panels without screensaver entry (they keep the screensaver of the script): %s
screensaver_weather_favorit_hint: Current weather from the weather adapter - an own item replaces it
screensaver_weather_hint: The favorite shows the current weather as long as no own item is placed there; the chosen extra items are appended to the bottom area.
screensaver_weather_noInstances: No supported weather adapter installed (accuweather, openweathermap, pirate-weather, brightsky).
screensaver_weather_scrollHint: Bottom: %s items on %s places - the panel pages through them (rotation time behind the gear), here the scroll bar moves them.
screensaver_weather_unsupported: The adapter "%s" is not supported - a warning is logged and nothing is added.
scroll_arrow_hint: More items than places: the last place shows an arrow that pages on.
scroll_auto_hint: Like classic, the page also advances by itself after the set time.
scroll_classic_hint: More items than places: the double arrows of the panel page through them.
select_description: Select an item from the list on the left to edit its configuration.
sendToInitSessionLost: The setup was interrupted, please start it again
sendToIpTopicDifferent: IP address and topic belong to different panels
sendToNSPanelInitStep1Done: Step 1 of 3 done: MQTT access transferred, the panel has restarted
sendToNSPanelInitStep2Done: Step 2 of 3 done: base settings and time zone transferred
sendToNoInternetAccess: Tasmota device has no internet access
sendToReloadAdmin: The adapter was updated, please reload the admin page
sendToRequestFail2: Could not determine TFT firmware version online
sendToRequestFail3: Failed to send TFT firmware update command via MQTT
sendToRequestFailBerry: Did not receive download confirmation from Tasmota after berry installation
sendToStepTimeout: The adapter did not answer within 30 seconds, the setup keeps running in the background - see the adapter log
shutterClosedIsZero: The position of 0 is displayed as fully closed (maximally extended).
tasmotaSendTo: Send Tasmota settings to the panel
tasmotaSendToHelp: Send Tasmota settings to the panel.
tasmotaTool: Send Tasmota settings to the panel
tasmotaUpdateHelp: Update the Tasmota firmware on the panel.
tftInstallSendToMQTTHelp: Update TFT firmware on the panel.

Do you want to install the TFT firmware on this panel?

thermo2_applyBlocked: Apply needs a data source: an alias channel with the role thermostat or airCondition, or the set and actual temperature data points
thermo2_autoItem: Generated by the adapter from the alias: %s
thermo2_clickHeadline: Heat circuit: channel, data points, headline
thermo2_emptySlotHint: Click: add a page item for this heat circuit
thermo2_heatHint: With more than one heat circuit the selector slots take the first places around the ring; the default is the numeral icon of the circuit.
thermo2_line1: Line 1: actual temperature (the unit is used for the set temperature too)
thermo2_maxCircuits: At most 8 heat circuits (an airCondition counts twice)
thermo2_modeListHint: Empty = common.states of the mode data point, otherwise the list of the adapter: %s
thermo2_modeListLabel: Mode texts, one per line (line = value of the data point, starting at 0)
thermo2_moveHint: Items can be moved with the arrows or by dragging - also onto a free slot further back; the slots in between stay free. A deleted item leaves a free slot.
thermo2_noCircuit: At least one heat circuit with a channel is required, otherwise the page shows nothing
thermo2_panelHint: Click the headline, the values or the mode to open the settings; the nine slots are the page items (the ninth between - and +) (dashed = free, lock = taken by the adapter, green = this heat circuit only, blue = all). An airCondition channel gives two heat circuits.
thermo2_slotNotSorted: Sort order %s: the adapter fills only the eight side slots - this slot stays empty, an item here is not shown on the panel
thermo2_unusableCircuits: %s heat circuit(s) without data source - the adapter skips them
thermo2_valuesHint: Empty limits = adapter defaults (15 / 28 / 0.5). With the option "Values in tenths" in the NSPanel settings the values are given in tenths (25 = 2.5 °C).
thermo2_wrongRole: The channel %s has the role "%s" - expected thermostat or airCondition
thermo_headlineHint: Empty = unique ID of the page
thermo_intro: Classic thermostat page: one alias channel with the role thermostat or airCondition. The adapter reads the actual, set and humidity states below the channel; the buttons at the bottom are not configured but derived from the states it finds there (mode, boost, window open, ...).
thermo_limitsHint: Stored exactly like in the script. The panel counts in tenths of a degree: with a maximum of 100 or more the three values are tenths (100 = 10 °C, step 5 = 0.5 °C), with a maximum below 100 they count as degrees (step 0.5 = 0.5 °C). Empty = min/max/step of the set temperature state, without them 15 °C to 30 °C in steps of 0.5 °C.
thermo_unitHint: Empty = unit of the set temperature state
touch_hint_buttons: For operating buttons from other flows a double tap is required
trash_ics_file_path_help: Path to the .ics file in the ioBroker file system. Automatically filled in when uploading the file
trash_ics_upload_no_events: '%s' uploaded, but no appointments were found in the file.
trash_ics_upload_success: '%s' uploaded – %d appointments found. Please select the ones to display.
trash_number_of_entities: Number of trash entries on the page
unlock_setnavi_hint: Optional: NSPanel page to open on unlock — must be the page's uniqueName.
unlock_setnavi_placeholder: “UniqueName of the page to be opened (optional)”
updateTasmotaText:
Do you want to update the Tasmota firmware on this panel?

useBetaVersionTooltip: To enable, expert mode must be activated.
valueEntryDialog_dateFormat: Date Format (format string or State ID)
valueEntryDialog_dateFormatInvalid: Invalid format options (not valid JSON or not applicable)
valueEntryDialog_dateFormatOptionsHint: e.g. {"dateStyle": "short"} – leave empty to disable date formatting
valueEntryDialog_dateLocalHint: e.g. de-DE or en-US (auto-detected from browser)
valueEntryDialog_previewHint: Shows prefix + current value + unit + suffix. State IDs are resolved to their current value.
valueEntryDialog_textSizeTooltip:
On grid pages, the font size can be set to a value between 0 and 5.

webCertChainedHelp: Optional: intermediate certificates (chain), empty if the public certificate already contains them.
webFido: FIDO2 security key (WebAuthn) as alternative to the PIN
webFidoHelp: A security key or passkey can be used instead of the PIN. Keys are registered on the web panel page /auth/fido/register (needs the PIN once). Requirements: (1) HTTPS must be enabled for the web panels, (2) the web panel must be opened via a host name (DNS), not via an IP address, (3) the browser must trust the certificate - a self-signed certificate works when it is installed as trusted in the browser or the system.
webFidoInactive: FIDO2 is not active in the running instance (needs HTTPS and the option enabled and saved).
webFidoLoadError: Could not load the security keys - is the instance running?
webFidoNoKeys: No security key registered yet. Register one on the web panel page /auth/fido/register (link on the panel list).
webFidoRequirements: Requirements: (1) HTTPS must be enabled for the web panels, (2) the web panel must be opened via a host name (DNS), not via an IP address, (3) the browser must trust the certificate - a self-signed certificate works when it is installed as trusted in the browser or the system.
webHostHelp: Host name or address under which browsers reach the web panel server (used for the links in the admin and the address preview). Empty = detected automatically. With HTTPS/FIDO2 enter the name from the certificate.
webPanelAddText: A web panel shows the panel UI in a browser without NSPanel hardware. It is configured like a real panel via its topic; the topic is also its address: http(s)://<host>:<port>/<topic>.
webPanelInfo: Shows the panel UI in a web browser: ${data.webSecure ? 'https' : 'http'}://<ioBroker host>:${data.webPort || 8090}/<topic of the panel>. The browser behaves like an additional NSPanel with the same configuration.
webPanelNoTasmotaMaintain: A web panel has no Tasmota firmware and no TFT display, there is nothing to flash. Only the script applies.
webPanelTopicDuplicate: This topic is already used by another panel
webPanelTopicInvalid: Only letters, digits, _, - and / are allowed
webPanelTopicRequired: The topic must not be empty
webPanelTopicReserved: This path is used by the web server itself
webPinHelp: PIN every browser has to enter once before it may open a web panel (hardware clones and standalone web panels). Empty = no protection. Changing the PIN logs out all browsers.
webSecureHelp: Serves the web panels over HTTPS and WSS with the certificates selected below (ioBroker certificates, system settings). Without valid certificates the web panels stay off - there is no fallback to HTTP.

writeTasmotaTeleHint: When enabled, the telemetry data of the panel will be stored in the data points (panels/XXXXX/info/tasmota/sts....).
